pr.title: feat(kit/index): the secondary index every realm with a store was writing by hand

review.body:
## Copilot review overview ### 🔵 Needs a closer look Pagination accepts invalid pages and the public `Page` documentation incorrectly claims parity with `store.Store.Page`. **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** None
Resolved since last review (3) - [Copies of populated Index share tree but diverge in length](#discussion_r4154976319) - [Page returns non-nil empty slice at exact end boundary](#discussion_r4154976360) - [Documentation does not reference the new index package](#discussion_r4154919835)
Previously missed (2) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Clamp page input to the valid pagination range `r/​moul/​x/​kitindexdemo/​render.gno:36` The query accepts every parsed integer, including non-positive and out-of-range pages. Once the board has more than one page, `Render("?page=-1")` or `?page=999` passes that value to `Index.Page`, gets no rows, then reports “Nothing posted yet” with a footer such as “page -1 of 2”. Clamp the parsed value to the available 1-based range before rendering; this path is user input and the realm path becomes immutable when published.
Correct the inaccurate nil result contract documentation `p/​moul/​kit/​index/​index.gno:311` This public API comment says the nil result matches `store.Store.Page` exactly, but that method allocates and returns a non-nil empty slice for a page past the end (`p/moul/kit/store/store.gno:262-277`). The nil distinction is explicitly part of this new method's tests, so remove the incorrect equivalence rather than documenting two different contracts as identical.
